topic: Mediabunny - How does multimodal AI work?
teachingGoal: Images, audio, and text become compatible representations that a model can combine before producing one answer.

lines.text: Think of multimodal A.I. as one model taking different kinds of notes.
lines.caption: One model. Different kinds of notes.

lines.text: An image is a sketch: shapes, colours, and relationships.
lines.caption: Image -> visual notes

lines.text: Audio is a rhythm: sounds, tone, and timing.
lines.caption: Audio -> acoustic notes

lines.text: Text is a label: words, ideas, and context.
lines.caption: Text -> meaning notes

lines.text: Each sense becomes a representation: a shared kind of math.
lines.caption: Different senses -> shared representation

lines.text: The model combines those notes, then produces one answer.
lines.caption: Combine the notes -> one answer
